verdict.rationale: The product is a physical laptop processor (silicon hardware), not a software service, platform, or tool, so an official MCP server for agent connectivity is outside its product category. The evidence covers only hardware AI acceleration (NPU/GPU/CPU), consumer features, and adjacent Intel SDKs such as OpenVINO and oneAPI. None of it shows the chip itself shipping an MCP server, so nothing makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
